scientific_change: Immediately after the unchanged runner.load restores original004, synchronize only PPO.learning_rate to the exactly uniform restored optimizer parameter-group learning rate. Continue the original adaptive schedule. No other learning, objective, controller or simulator change.
hypothesis: Synchronizing the adaptive scalar may avoid the source-predicted high first-minibatch resume rate and preserve useful tracking during continued optimization. Whether this improves original uninterrupted grounded drift in both engines is unknown. One seed cannot establish causality or statistical robustness.

No gap bridging.
